Foot length measurement method

  • Put The Foot On White Paper And Point Out The Front And Rear Points At The Longest WithA Pen Leaving The Distance Between The Two Points As The Normal Foot Length.
  • It Should Be Subject To The Data Of The Big Foot in Case OfSlight Difference Between Left And Right Foot Size.
  • It ls Recommended To Choose A Size Larger For High instep And Wide And Fat FeetIt ls Recommended To Choose A Normal Size For Flat Back And Thin Feet.
  • The Measured Size Should Always Match To The Size You Normally Wear.

Shipping Policy

    ANTA PG7 TRAVEL 2

    Next-level cushioning. Effortless stride.Powered by PG7.
    Designed for your daily run and everyday commute.

Effortless Miles

Heel Stability
The visible Peak Gravity 7.8 midsole tech offers a hint of the soft, energy-returning material beneath.
Forefoot Sole Traction
Precisely placed rubber elements ensure a steady grip, prolonging the outsole’s life and maintaining a clean profile.
Mesh Upper
Combines strategic breathability with a structured, dirt-resistant knit finish. It delivers a secure, locked-in fit while remaining effortless to clean after every run.
